structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The outlook remains spacious, tranquil and desirable, with the park and city continuously presented as one panoramic vista.

outputs.scene_plan: For the 3.2-second continuous shot, begin the breeze immediately at low amplitude, moving the treetops in a gentle coherent wave while the central fountain mist drifts slightly right and small ripples develop on the pond.
